## Summary

Describe the change and the reason for it.

## Related issue

Link the issue or write `Not applicable`.

## Change type

- [ ] Build or package configuration
- [ ] CI or repository maintenance
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Implemented user-visible feature
- [ ] Security or recovery

## Scope and safety

- [ ] I kept this change focused on the stated scope.
- [ ] I did not overwrite or delete unrelated working files or user data.
- [ ] I considered compatibility, security, resource use, and rollback.
- [ ] I documented any migration or irreversible operation.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, signing keys, or private data.

## Validation evidence

List the exact commands and outcomes. Link GitHub Actions runs and artifacts where applicable.

- [ ] Repository validation passed.
- [ ] Relevant shell/workflow tests passed.
- [ ] Build or runtime tests passed where applicable.
- [ ] Any unrun tests and remaining risks are explicitly listed.

## Documentation and status

- [ ] Documentation is updated.
- [ ] Project status reflects only verified evidence.
- [ ] No planned, mock, or placeholder feature is described as implemented.

## Reviewer notes

List compatibility concerns, known limitations, and follow-up work.
